auth.login_failed: The sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
auth.cross_origin: This request did not come from the application's own page.
auth.host_only: This is a host action; an administrator manages the instance, they do not present.

host.forbidden: You are not the host of this session.

quiz.not_ready: The quiz must be “ready” to start a session (RG-02).
quiz.requires_question: A quiz must have at least one question to become “ready” (RG-02).
quiz.in_use: This quiz is being played in a session: end the session first.

session.banned: You have been removed from this session by the host.
session.reveal_required: Action only possible after the reveal.
session.timer_not_adjustable: The timer can only be adjusted during a question.
session.capture_locked: Full capture can only be changed before the session starts.
session.options_locked: The session options can only be changed before the session starts.
session.archive_quiz_gone: The quiz was deleted during the session: it ended without an archive.
session.locked: This game no longer accepts new participants.
session.open_access_forbidden: Open access is not allowed on this server.
session.open_access_guests_only: In open access participants have no account: no personal tracking, no name taken from an account.

nickname.taken: This nickname is already taken in this session.
nickname.invalid_length: The nickname must be between {{min}} and {{max}} characters.

pin.unavailable: Could not allocate a PIN, please try again.
pin.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong PINs from this address. Try again in a minute.

media.unsupported_type: Unsupported format: an image, an MP4 video (H.264) or a sound (MP3, M4A). The editor converts the other files this browser can read; SVG is not accepted.
media.file_too_large: File too large (at most {{maxMb}} MB for this kind of media).
media.demo_disabled: Media uploads are disabled on the demo instance.
media.video_with_audio: A video already carries its own sound: remove the audio track or the video.
media.wrong_kind: This media is not of the kind this slot takes.
media.embeds_disabled: YouTube and Vimeo videos are turned off on this instance.
media.invalid: The question’s media are not valid.
media.quicktime: QuickTime files (.mov) are not accepted. Export the video as MP4 (H.264), for instance with HandBrake (handbrake.fr).
media.unsupported_video_codec: Unsupported video codec ({{codec}}). Only H.264 plays everywhere. A video shot on an iPhone is often HEVC: convert it to MP4 H.264, for instance with HandBrake (handbrake.fr), or set the camera to “Most Compatible”.
media.unsupported_audio_codec: The sound of this video ({{codec}}) is not AAC. Export it again as MP4 H.264 + AAC, for instance with HandBrake (handbrake.fr).
media.no_video_track: This file holds no video. For a sound on its own, use the sound slot.
media.unreadable_mp3: This sound cannot be read: the file looks damaged.
media.metadata_invalid: What was measured on the sound is not valid ({{field}}). Try the upload again.
media.cannot_read: This browser cannot read this file. Try another browser, or convert it first with a dedicated tool (HandBrake for videos, Audacity for sounds).
media.cannot_convert_video: This browser cannot convert this video to MP4 H.264. Use Chrome, Edge or Safari, or convert it first with HandBrake (handbrake.fr).
media.cannot_convert_audio: This browser cannot convert this sound to AAC. Try another browser, or convert it first with Audacity (audacityteam.org).
media.too_long: Too long to fit the {{maxMb}} MB limit for this kind of media, even compressed. Shorten it first.
media.in_use: This media is still used by a quiz or a session: remove it from there first.
media.playing: A session is playing this media right now: try again once it ends.
media.not_adopted_yet: This file is being moved to shared storage: try again in a moment.

import.invalid_bundle: Not a QuizDock bundle (quiz.json + media/, zipped).
import.media_missing: Media “{{path}}” is referenced but missing from the bundle.
import.media_unsupported: Unsupported media “{{path}}” (png, jpg, gif, webp, avif, mp3, ogg, wav, m4a).
import.invalid_item: Item {{item}} of the bundle is invalid ({{field}}).

question.not_in_quiz: Question not part of the quiz.
question.reorder_incomplete: Reordering must list all questions of the quiz.

host_seat.taken: The host seat is already taken.
host_seat.manager_forbidden: An administrator does not take the host seat.

store.demo_disabled: Sharing is off on a demo instance.
store.not_ready: Only a quiz marked “ready” can be shared.
store.license_required: Set a licence before sharing: a template is meant to be reused, so the terms travel with it.
store.entry_not_found: This template is no longer in the catalogue.
store.not_yours: Only its author, or an administrator, can withdraw a template.
store.index_unreadable: The catalogue index cannot be read; ask your administrator.

publication.slug_invalid: The short name must be lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
publication.not_ready: Only a ready quiz can be exported for publication.
publication.license: Choose a licence (CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA) before exporting for publication.
publication.language: The quiz language is not valid.
publication.tags: Add at least one tag before exporting for publication.
publication.too_large: The quiz is too large for the community store.
